title: Travel: John Lennon – Syracuse to New York City | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Syracuse to New York City on 10 October 1971.

They had been in Syracuse for the launch of This Is Not Here, a retrospective of Ono’s art at the Everson Museum of Art. They returned to Manhattan, where they were staying at the St Regis Hotel until 1 November.
